title: Redis cache crashes repeatedly
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the cache as the failing component, describes a crash caused by a segmentation fault, and attributes it to the Lua script introduced in API version 2.3.2.
root_cause: The API version 2.3.2 introduced a Lua script that runs inside Redis 7.4 and triggers a known Lua engine bug, causing segmentation faults (signal 11) and repeated cache container crashes.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced a new Lua script for atomic cart updates that triggers a segmentation fault in Redis 7.4, causing the cache to crash and restart every few minutes under load.
